name: Beyond Artificial
source:
Near future.
  The protagonist, Chow Shei - a talented programmer who is studying in a prestigious Chinese university. On the first year he receives a large sum of money and spends it on creating his own actroid.
  The heroine, Lin - actually, his actroid.
  Over four game days, they develop an unusual relationship.
translation: 近未来。主人公周时——一名在中国名牌大学就读的天才程序员。大一那年他收到了一大笔钱，用来制作了自己的仿生人。女主角琳——实际上是他的仿生人。在四个游戏日中，他们发展出了一段不寻常的关系。
